headline: Blanked, but with chances
record_line: Yesterday: 0-4 on the top plays · Season: 28-113

entries.headline: Shohei Ohtani stayed in the yard
entries.story: Shohei Ohtani went 0-for-3 with 1 BB against Lake Bachar and the Pittsburgh Pirates. No real scare on the HR front.

entries.headline: Pete Alonso stayed in the yard
entries.story: Pete Alonso went 0-for-4 against Nick Martinez and the Tampa Bay Rays. No real scare on the HR front.

entries.headline: Kazuma Okamoto came close
entries.story: Kazuma Okamoto went 1-for-3 with 1 BB against Carlos Rodón and the New York Yankees. Closest call was a double in the 9th: "Kazuma Okamoto doubles (20) on a line drive to right fielder Spencer Jones." The power showed up; the carry did not.

entries.headline: Ben Rice stayed in the yard
entries.story: Ben Rice went 2-for-5 with 2 RBI against José Soriano and the Toronto Blue Jays. No real scare on the HR front, striking out 3 times.
